patch_description:
The current plan fails due to invalid contact schedules where contacts change directly without going through a free () mode. To address this, we need to ensure that every transition between different contact points includes a free mode. This can be achieved by modifying the plan to insert a free mode between any transition that changes the contact point without already being free.

This will help the solver understand that the robot should release its grip before changing contact surfaces, thus adhering to the solver constraints.
